operation.storage: Current operation only, in memory; discarded on pagehide/session or canonical account/team/role/session_version change
operation.key: crypto.randomUUID created once before profile preparation; explicit preparation of another operation creates a new UUID
operation.retry: Original key and frozen DTO retained. Successful profile PUT is not repeated. No automatic new request after ambiguous response
operation.profile_failure: Generation POST is not sent unless profile PUT confirms success
operation.unknown_result: History opens another tab without losing the current operation; native retry uses the same key
operation.intentional_new_request: Explicit review/preparation first refreshes the client count and warns that another request may consume another available plan
operation.timeout: 60 seconds without confirmation shows recovery; it does not cancel or refund the server reservation
operation.finished_response: Requires success=true, matching client and plan type, positive plan id, finite macro totals and nonempty meal objects. No partial success after render failure

pdf.identity: Bearer and canonical account checks before/after; no latest-plan fallback
pdf.download: Anchor click then prepared message; no claim that the user saved the file
pdf.cleanup: Blob URL revoked after 2 seconds or pagehide; response after session change discarded
pdf.legacy_helper: Api.planes.descargar remains an explicitly latest-client-plan compatibility helper; both changed templates use descargarPorPlan

real: same-key exact JSON replay and one plan history
explicit new DTO key and real Free quota denial
exact owned PDF and real 401/404 boundaries
evidence.accessibility: Scoped axe AA only: parameters, results/recovery and history; keyboard Enter retry; responsive 320/390/768/1440 for results
not_claimed: Production/PostgreSQL deployment validation from this browser fixture
A saved local file confirmed by the user
R26 effective entitlement UI or a grace/quota policy
